method: Deterministic arithmetic + read-only audit; rerun recreates this JSON. Only this file is written.

theoretical.status: Derived arithmetic for hypothetical frozen valid-Conv/ReLU/GAP architecture; no trained K12 model is asserted.

marginal_vs_joint_coverage.status: Illustrative only, conditional on independent coordinate events with equal marginal probability q; not a HAPT independence assumption or coverage estimate.
marginal_vs_joint_coverage.union_bound: P(intersection E_i) >= max(0, 1-sum alpha_i), if P(not E_i)<=alpha_i

cnn.flop_note: Excludes bias addition, ReLU comparisons, GAP operations, indexing and memory traffic.

legacy_timing_sensitivity_only.warning: A recorded forward latency of a different K6 model is used only as a scalar example; no new runtime or K12 baseline claim.

structured_margin_example.scope: Different sets are compared; no matched-volume, matched-coverage or HAPT performance claim.

tail_interval_example.requirement: For K classes, every one of the K-1 target-competitor margins must be certified.

current_data_audit.status: Fresh read-only audit of existing NPZ and Parquet; no data regenerated.

exact_raw_overlap.comparison: X_t[:,64:128] == X_(t+1)[:,0:64], componentwise exact float32 equality, only same-recording consecutive win_idx pairs
exact_raw_overlap.scope_limit: This verifies stored raw overlap and the index bridge. It does not prove same-coordinate closeness, feature reuse, labels, certificate validity or runtime savings.

diagonal_box_audit.status: Fresh arithmetic from existing raw arrays, same train-fit definition as scripts/05; no verifier or neural model used.
diagonal_box_audit.scope_limit: Empirical geometry coverage is neither model certifiability nor certified cache hit rate. Raw mixed-unit coordinates are not directly comparable to normalized P0 radii.

current_data_audit.annotation_limit: Reuses the stored policy labels. Does not independently settle the original annotation indexing convention or relabel raw samples.

legacy_appendix.status: Archived K6 observations; only arithmetic on stored artifacts is recomputed now. No fresh training, inference, verification or latency measurement.

three_seed_summary.rounding_note: scripts/09 aggregates per-seed metrics already rounded to four decimals, with NumPy std ddof=0. The exact-confusion arithmetic and sample std ddof=1 are separately identified.

P0.sample_policy: np.random.seed(42); uniform sample without replacement of 100 correctly predicted validation pure-K6 windows. Source comment says stratified but no stratification is implemented.
P0.equivalence_check: Stored eq_err=0 on only 10 random (6,128) tensors; not an exhaustive floating-point equivalence proof.
P0.replay_policy: 1-entry anchor; validation pure-K6 windows sorted by exp/win_idx; reset across recordings. Filtered windows may have gaps because win_idx adjacency is not enforced after filtering.
not_end_to_end_reasons: Replay never calls the verifier and does not gate hits on certified status.
Replay and certifiability sample use different anchor populations; product p_c*r is not measured joint certified-hit probability.
Radius grids are different; no certifiability observation exists for replay k=0.1 or k=0.28.
Only membership hits are counted; no ECDR fallback/lookup/state/energy/end-to-end timing is measured.
The sample excludes incorrectly predicted anchors; sampled p_c is conditional, not a full validation certified fraction.
Radii are normalized coordinates and cannot be equated to raw-coordinate event-box budgets.
